description: Messages API, streamed text then a tool_use block
source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/streaming (Full HTTP stream response, Streaming request with tool use)

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Get the current weather in a given location

location.description: The city and state, e.g. San Francisco, CA

messages.content: What is the weather like in San Francisco?

completion.text: Okay, let's check the weather for San Francisco, CA:

ignoreRealEvents.ping: a keep-alive the API may send at any point; the Messages streaming docs tell clients to handle it, so a stream without one is valid
